name: Bram Stoker
bio: A young Irish civil servant with literary and dramatic interests when he married Florence Balcombe at St Anne's Church, Dublin, on 4 December 1878. Wilde had courted Balcombe for the two years before the engagement, and the parting letters he wrote her are the reason both she and Stoker appear on this map.
bio_note: Everything above comes from one editorial footnote - Holland and Hart-Davis's note to Wilde's parting letters to Balcombe, Complete Letters (2000), p. 72 n. 1, which gives the wedding date, the church, the husband and his dates.
